_note: This app's own record of the routes and field names it uses, verified against the live site. It is a deliberate SECOND copy: the FitSys scheduler has its own, richer map covering write routes and discovery, which this app has no business carrying. tests/test_notifier.py compares the two whenever the scheduler happens to be present on the same machine, so drift is caught in development -- but there is no runtime dependency on it.
_scope: Read-only. There are no write routes here because there is no write code in this app.

calendar.site_id_note: Read from the calendar page's bootstrap JSON ("siteId": N) and cached; set a number here to pin it.
calendar.chunk_note: A 4-week request once died mid-response (IncompleteRead); weekly slices succeeded, so reads are chunked.
calendar.include_types_note: Feed 'type' seen live: 'class' (a studio class), 'reservation' (an individual client booking) and 'event' (room rentals, pest control). Only classes are watched.

events_endpoint.note: GET only -- POST returns 500. Returns {"events": [...]}. The sibling route /calendar/get-events also works but includes customer names and ids, which this app must never hold.

instructor_pattern.note: instructor_names looks like '2581_Фани М' -- id, underscore, name.
